content_html:
Watched #Crew : it’s been ages since Bollywood came up with a PROPER Women Centric Movie without any Agenda or Propaganda or Forced Feminism….I remember #Kahani was the last one such movie, while Kahani was a Crime Thriller….CREW is a proper commercial entertainer 😍 which boosts of having some wonderful artists Tabu, Kareena & Kriti Sanon

Being a proper commercial movie the content has its own ups and downs wrt logic or cinematic freedom (which general Bollywood critics and so called Directors worry about a lot) but all that goes for a toss with some wonderful performances……Special Kudos to the Casting department for such an apt casting!!!

All three of Tabu, Kareena & Kirti were on fire both looks and performance wise and they carried the movie wonderfully on their shoulders 🙏 The best part I loved in this movie was just how in Hero centric movies there is nothing for a Heroines….similarly this commercial Women centric movie has nothing much for its Hero’s 🤣

The special surprise of this movie is Kapil Sharma who played a subtle role as Tabu’s husband which is completely opposite to what we expect from Kapil Sharma and he did a very good job 👍

If you have watched Rajesh Krishnan’s last comedy thriller #Lootcase this movie Crew is pretty much similar Comedy Crime movie which shows the ups and downs of three air hostess with witty dialogues and performances by the 3 main ladies!!!
